**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 9.0(f), paragraph p0189).**

- **What we found:** The only solicitation restraint in the Agreement is one-way against us — IBM agrees not to solicit Transferred Employees for "[*] years" from the Effective Date. There is no restraint on MSL (not flagged, since its absence doesn't burden us), and no no-hire appears anywhere in the document.
- **Already at/above fallback:** narrow scope (Transferred Employees only, i.e. the personnel delivering the Products), pure non-solicit rather than no-hire, and express carve-outs for unsolicited approaches, general employment advertising/communications and independent search firms.
- **Why it deviates:** duration. A multi-year period exceeds the 12 months our fallback allows (short of walk-away unless the redacted figure exceeds 24 months).
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** reset to "twelve (12) months from the Effective Date of this Agreement," leaving scope and carve-outs untouched, with an 18-month landing zone offered in the comment.
